name: zinterp_context_set_macro
description: zInterp_Context::SetMacro defines or updates an interpreter macro entry.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zInterp parser/runtime source-cluster pass.

Binary Ninja renders the update path strlen/memcpy sequence as split builtin_memcpy calls; assembly review confirms realloc of the existing value buffer followed by copying the replacement value including its null terminator.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4c1780 validates null name/value rejection, FindMacroValue lookup, reallocating and copying an existing value, growing macroTable by one 8-byte entry, storing _strdup(name)/_strdup(value), incrementing macroCount, and returning success.
The native smoke verifies null rejection, adding a first macro, updating the existing macro without adding an entry, and adding a second macro.
